# Sanatan Dharma Saral (sanatan.space)

> A free, plain-language guide to Sanatan Dharma (Hinduism): the Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Ramayana, Mahabharata and Puranas. Every mantra is given in Sanskrit with transliteration, word-by-word meaning, translation and a simple explanation, plus stories for children and a festival calendar. Non-commercial, no sign-up.

Translations follow the most widely accepted traditional meaning; where schools differ, pages say so. Historical dates follow mainstream historians. Contact: contact@sanatan.space

## Start here

- [Hinduism Explained Simply: Gita, Vedas & Stories for Families](https://sanatan.space/): A simple guide to Hinduism for families: the Bhagavad Gita, Vedas, Upanishads, Ramayana and festivals, with every mantra in Sanskrit, its meaning and plain English.
- [Bhagavad Gita Explained Simply: All 18 Chapters with Meaning](https://sanatan.space/gita.html): Read the Bhagavad Gita in simple English: what happens in all 18 chapters, with key verses in Sanskrit, transliteration, translation and a plain explanation.
- [The 11 Principal Upanishads Explained Simply, with Stories](https://sanatan.space/upanishads.html): The 11 principal Upanishads explained simply: Isha, Kena, Katha and more, with key verses in Sanskrit, plain meanings and the stories behind them.
- [Ramayana and Mahabharata Explained Simply, Book by Book](https://sanatan.space/epics.html): The Ramayana and Mahabharata explained simply, book by book, with family trees, key verses in Sanskrit and the lessons each story teaches.
- [The Puranas Explained: Vishnu's 10 Avatars & Festival Stories](https://sanatan.space/puranas.html): The 18 Puranas explained simply: Vishnu's ten avatars, the stories behind Hindu festivals, and what each Purana is about.

## The Vedas

- [Rigveda Explained Simply: Gayatri & Key Hymns with Meaning](https://sanatan.space/rigveda.html): The Rigveda explained simply: the Gayatri Mantra, the Creation Hymn and other key hymns in Sanskrit, with word-by-word meaning and stories.
- [Yajurveda Explained Simply: Key Mantras with Meaning](https://sanatan.space/yajurveda.html): The Yajurveda explained simply: its key mantras and prayers in Sanskrit, with word-by-word meaning, translation and what they mean for daily life.
- [Samaveda Explained Simply: The Veda of Song](https://sanatan.space/samaveda.html): The Samaveda, the Veda of song, explained simply: how the Rigveda's hymns became music, with key verses, meanings and stories.
- [Atharvaveda Explained Simply: Key Mantras with Meaning](https://sanatan.space/atharvaveda.html): The Atharvaveda explained simply: prayers for health, family and the Earth, including the Bhumi Sukta, in Sanskrit with plain meanings.

## Practice and festivals

- [Hindu Festival Calendar 2026–27: Dates for India & USA](https://sanatan.space/calendar.html): Hindu festival dates for 2026 and 2027 for India and the US East Coast, from Diwali to Holi and Janmashtami, each linked to the story behind it.
- [Diwali 2026: The 5 Days, Lakshmi Puja at Home & Stories](https://sanatan.space/diwali.html): Diwali 2026 day by day, Dhanteras to Bhai Dooj: a simple 20-minute Lakshmi Puja at home, prayers with meaning, and the stories to tell your kids.
- [Guided Om & Mantra Meditation with Breathing](https://sanatan.space/meditate.html): A free guided Om and mantra meditation with a breathing circle, follow-along chanting, and a verse to match how you feel today. No sound needed.
- [Yoga in Hindu Scriptures: Meaning, 8 Limbs & a Family Routine](https://sanatan.space/yoga.html): What the Hindu scriptures say about yoga: Patanjali's eight limbs, the Gita's four paths, and a gentle 11-minute routine for the whole family.
- [Hindu Symbols & Their Meanings: Om, Swastika, Lotus, Tilak](https://sanatan.space/symbols.html): What Hindu symbols mean: Om, the swastika, lotus, conch, trishul, diya, kalash, tilak, rudraksha and tulsi, explained simply with their sources.

## Places

- [25 Famous Hindu Temples: Stories, Facts & Visiting Tips](https://sanatan.space/temples.html): 25 famous Hindu temples in India and abroad, from Kashi Vishwanath to Angkor Wat: their stories, amazing facts and tips for visiting.
- [Char Dham, 12 Jyotirlingas & 51 Shakti Peethas Explained](https://sanatan.space/tirthas.html): Hindu pilgrimage circuits explained simply: the Char Dham, Chota Char Dham, 12 Jyotirlingas, 51 Shakti Peethas and 108 Divya Desams, with their stories.
- [Maps: Rama's Journey, Mahabharata Places, 12 Jyotirlingas](https://sanatan.space/maps.html): Interactive maps of Rama's journey, Mahabharata places, the 12 Jyotirlingas and the Char Dham. Tap a pin to read the story of each place.

## Families and children

- [Hindu Stories for Kids: Ganesha, Hanuman, Krishna & More](https://sanatan.space/kids.html): Short Hindu stories for kids aged 5 to 12: Ganesha, Hanuman, Prahlad, Dhruva, Krishna and more. Read or listen, then answer two questions to earn stars.
- [Hinduism Quiz & Mantra Flashcards for Kids and Families](https://sanatan.space/learn.html): Test what you know about Hinduism with a 34-question quiz and mantra flashcards for families, from the Vedas and Upanishads to the Gita and epics.
- [Free Diwali Greeting Card Maker: English, Hindi, Gujarati](https://sanatan.space/diwali-card.html): Make a free Diwali or New Year card in English, Hindi or Gujarati with your family's name, and share it on WhatsApp or as your Status. Nothing is saved.
- [Free Printable Diwali Coloring Pages for Kids](https://sanatan.space/diwali-colouring.html): Free printable Diwali coloring pages for kids: a big diya and a rangoli to color in, for home, school or Bal Vihar.

## Science and health in the tradition

- [Science in Ancient India: Zero, Pi, Surgery, Steel, with Sources](https://sanatan.space/ancient-science.html): Real achievements of Indian mathematics, astronomy, medicine and engineering up to 1800 CE, from the Shulba Sutras and Aryabhata to the Kerala school, each with its source. Part of Sanatan Dharma Saral, a simple guide to Hinduism.
- [Ayurveda Explained Simply: Doshas, Daily Routine & Safety](https://sanatan.space/ayurveda.html): Where Ayurveda comes from, its great books, the three doshas, a daily and seasonal routine, the spice box, and how to use it safely. Part of Sanatan Dharma Saral, a simple guide to Hinduism.
